title: Print Citation Page Backreferences
description: Add a page-number list at the end of every bibliography citation entry showing all pages where it is cited. Make citation links bidirectional: in-text citation to bibliography entry, bibliography page number back to the corresponding cited page. Verify on the Entwerfen mit Bestand Zwischenbericht in light and dark output.
summary: Enabled native biblatex back-reference tracking for the shared print class so every bibliography entry ends with a deduplicated list of pages where it is cited. Existing in-text citation links continue to jump to bibliography entries, while each listed page number links back to the cited page. Added a source-level regression assertion. Verified the Entwerfen mit Bestand Zwischenbericht in light and dark: 148 forward citation links, 143 bibliography page backlinks, and zero unresolved destinations in each 127-page PDF; visually inspected the first bibliography page in both themes. The print long test rebuilt all 12 shared template PDFs successfully.
